Implemented on task/ravel-amn.1 (stacked on task/ravel-k3z), PR #65. Design settled in TWO judge cycles: cycle 1 ruled the capped-overlay mechanism and the candidate binding from probe evidence; two independent sign-off lanes then returned SIGN OFF WITH CONDITIONS with 7 blocking objections, ALL accepted in cycle 2, which deleted two of its own cycle-1 proof points and added one correction neither lane made. Rulings: e06-amn1-overlay-freshness, e06-amn1-authority-window, e06-amn1-launch-policy-digest, e06-amn1-containment-privacy. Key outcomes: the runner enters one private user+mount namespace at startup and mounts each attempt overlay as its own 8 GiB capped tmpfs there with bwrap as the direct child, so runtime.md's mount table is implementable exactly as written and needs no amendment; overlay freshness is PER LAUNCH because a shared overlay let a candidate build.rs plant HOME/.cargo/config.toml and make a failing evaluator report PASS (probe-demonstrated, rc=0 shared vs rc=101 fresh); the gate bounds the LAUNCH DECISION rather than the run, since the authority window is at most ~25s against a frozen 1800s wall clock and cycle-1's expiry-kill clause would have SIGKILLed every attempt into a FAIL verdict; the policy digest carries no command tag, or the frozen four-command sweep would be unissuable at one claim fence; candidate argv is frozen trusted configuration (closed 4-variant enum transcribed from change/contract.md), so no new durable record and no prerequisite bead were needed. Review: wave 1 (rust-code-reviewer, security-reviewer, invariant-test-review, less-code) found 4 blocking - preflight ran an EvaluatorCommand with no EffectAuthority while the compliance test's scan region had been narrowed to end exactly where the violation began; the public-spawn invariant did not close the set; the namespace comparator test tested a copy of itself; the gate test covered 1 of 4 comparands. Implemented on task/ravel-amn.2 (stacked on task/ravel-amn.1), PR to follow. New src/materialize.rs returns a typed MaterializedBase only after verifying the frozen commit, the frozen tree, and the sha256 of git archive output, extracting only after that digest matches. Fetch is a bare repo from an empty template with inherited environment cleared, system and global config disabled, prompts off, core.hooksPath=/dev/null and no checkout; the tree parser rejects non-blob types, modes other than 100644/100755, and .gitmodules / .gitattributes / .cargo/config* at any depth, so repository-supplied hooks, filters and attributes never act. MaterializedBase has no public path accessor, no Deref and no AsRef<Path>, and LaunchPaths::new now REQUIRES it, so amn.1's sandbox can no longer be handed a raw source path — that closes amn.1 residual R11 and makes launch-kind confusability compiler-enforced end to end. Design: spec-pipeline then two independent sign-off lanes, both SIGN OFF WITH CONDITIONS, folded in as binding amendments A1-A6. A1 OVERTURNED the spec's own plan to shell out to python3 for the collision key: a lane probe showed the frozen base tree is 66 entries, max 41 bytes, depth 3 and ZERO non-ASCII, so an ASCII-restricted Rust key equals the frozen key here and is strictly stricter in general, removing a subprocess, a hex protocol and the host unicodedata dependency from the trusted path; the 19 golden vectors were also shown unable to bound Unicode-version drift, since every vector input is assigned in Unicode 1.1 and reproduces identically on 15.1. Ruling recorded as e06-amn2-base-collision-key; the general key and its version ruling are deferred to ravel-amn.4 and noted there. A3 fixed a probe-demonstrated build break: cargo discovers configuration from cwd upward, so a host-side cargo invocation inside the snapshot picks up the trusted .cargo/config.toml whose target-dir and vendor directory are in-sandbox paths; every host cargo call now runs with cwd outside the snapshot and --manifest-path pointing in. A4 ruled the first Git effect EXCLUDED BY RULING rather than gated (a fetch is a read, the result is pinned by three frozen values, there is no third-party spend, and gating is operationally impossible because materialization precedes host isolation and any claim, so no authority exists to consume) and e06-effect-gate-taxonomy was amended accordingly: Git moved out of GENUINELY ABSENT into entry 5, leaving only the code host absent. Review: wave 1 (rust-code-reviewer 0 blocking, security-reviewer 0 blocking, invariant-test-review 2 blocking) found that the ENTIRE AC3 tree preflight was unwired-detectable — replacing the validate_tree call with a no-op left all offline tests green because the parser was proven only in isolation — and that A2's mandated materialized-tree ASCII assertion was vacuous against an all-ASCII fixture; also that the permission guard survived four mutations (mask narrowed to 0o002 or 0o020, symlink_metadata to metadata, and dropping the directory recursion). Both fixed with mutation proofs: unwiring validate_tree now fails a non-ASCII-fixture test driven through the whole pipeline, and the permission test is a rejected/accepted twin set that kills all four mutants. Wave 2 (doc-rigor 0 blocking, ponytail-review 1 blocking) resurrected a wave-1 finding that had been DECLINED and proved the decline wrong: git archive always records 0664/0775 and tar --no-same-permissions masks with the AMBIENT umask, so at umask 002 or 000 the group-write bit survives and materialization rejects its own frozen base — data-free error, every retry identical, passing under systemd's 0022 and failing on a developer shell. Fixed by pinning the child's umask in pre_exec so extracted modes depend on the archive rather than the caller's shell; verified passing at umask 022, 002 and 000, and the mutation (child umask 002) fails. Gates: fmt, clippy -D warnings, 338 lib + 3 ignored + 2 CLI + 9 live-S3 + 14 wire tests, all 7 Linux host tests RUN and PASS including the four-evaluator sweep and host-side vendoring, PREFLIGHT-PASS, no new Cargo dependency, wire fixtures byte-unchanged, the five frozen pilot/e01 files byte-identical to main, and git diff against the stack parent shows amn.2 adds NO pilot/e01 amendment. INHERITED CLAUSES SATISFIED: trusted .cargo/config.toml sets [build] target-dir = /work/out/target, which satisfies the INTENT of contract.md's fresh CARGO_TARGET_DIR and not its literal env-var wording (runtime.md forbids env vars beyond PATH/HOME/TMPDIR); a real ld is copied into the toolchain rather than binding /etc/alternatives; the toolchain carries a vendored dependency cache with source replacement, because per-launch overlay freshness empties CARGO_HOME every launch; and this bead owns the positive compile+link fixture.
